lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white spots arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a grid-like distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of varying luminance intersect with horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating distinct anchor points in a repeating geometric pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradient.

other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high density of small-diameter high-luminance spots localized on the anterior cranial and snout region.
